title: Change the details on a motor vehicle tradesperson certificate
summary: Learn how to notify NSW Fair Trading if your name or contact details have changed on your motor vehicle tradesperson certificate.
intro:
If you hold a motor vehicle tradesperson certificate and your name or contact information has changed, you need to notify NSW Fair Trading.

To look up your certificate number and details, visit Verify NSW.
who_can_apply: You hold a motor vehicle tradesperson certificate and your name or contact information has changed.
what_you_need: Evidence of your name change, such as a change of name or marriage certificate (if applicable)
The PDF form: 'Change of name or contact details'

how_to_steps.text: Complete the form, including the declaration.
Attach your supporting document for change of name (if applicable).
Submit the form and attachment (if applicable):

faqs.q: How do I check my certificate number and details?
faqs.a: You can look up your certificate number and details by visiting Verify NSW.

faqs.q: What do I need to change my details?
faqs.a: You need your certificate number, evidence of your name change (if applicable), and the 'Change of name or contact details' PDF form.

faqs.q: Where do I submit the form?
faqs.a: You can submit the form and attachment at a Service NSW Centre.
